title: Swarm word
suits: data, geo, mapping, AI and analytics products: anything whose material is many small signals becoming one picture

params.--field: the field (ultramarine by default; any colour or gradient)
params.--brand: the accent: the last points to land (used if it reads on the field and differs from the points)
params.--swarm-fs: wordmark size the points are sampled from (long names shrink to fit 1700 px)
params.__MARK__: stroke paths in a 24 x 24 box; the points sample its strokes; the last stroke (or the tail of a single stroke) lands last in the accent

details: about 5,200 points whatever the name: the sampling step adapts to the glyph area
targets are sampled from the deck font itself on an offscreen canvas after document.fonts.ready
on the press the points appear scattered and already drifting, so the first frame is a field, not a blank
every point curves in on its own arc instead of flying straight
fast points stretch into short streaks; they become round dots as they slow
the word assembles roughly left to right, so it reads as it forms
each point overshoots its slot by a hair and settles back
about 2% are stragglers that leave late and land last among the white
the very last points fill the mark's accent part in the accent colour, each landing with a small ping ring
two dot sizes and two brightnesses, so the glyphs have texture rather than a flat fill
at rest every point breathes 0.6 px on the deck clock, out of phase with its neighbours
a soft light wave crosses the word every 9 s
34 free points never join and keep drifting through the field
a faint glow rises behind the word as it forms
the points take the readable ink for the field, so they are white on dark fields and near-black on light ones
